:::{#def-joint-surprisal}
#### Joint surprisal

Let $X$ and $Y$ be [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv)
with [joint probability mass function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-joint-pmf) $p(x, y) \eqdef \P(X=x, Y=y)$.
The **joint surprisal** of a pair of [values](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-realization) $(x, y)$ with $p(x, y) > 0$
is the [surprisal](#def-surprisal) of that pair:

$$\surprisalf{x, y} \eqdef -\log p(x, y).$$

:::
